title: Value pages leave about 50pt of empty band under the last line, and show "Tap a value to correct it." right under "No values yet."
evidence: Hint done: ValuePage.tsx shows it only when the history holds a value (US-62 AC10a, ValuePage.hint.test.tsx). Band open: measured 52px in real WebKit at 390 = the empty live region (.md-page-messages, 22px line held by an NBSP so the visible "Added." / "No change." can show) + the theme's 14px p margin above it + the card's 16px padding. Cutting it to row padding means hiding that visible status line or moving it, a behaviour call for the orchestrator. Seen in the PR 1508 shots. (H82)
